svg.aria-label: The llm4j stack: build, orchestrate, test, watch, ship
svg.text: THE WHOLE STACK, ONE EXPERIENCE
Where you work
VS Code extension · weave CLI (one command per job) · your coding agent (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, AGENTS.md) · weave man
Loom: workflows that run for days
A small language: journaled and resumable, budgeted, scheduled,
human approvals, retries and handlers, earned autonomy,
steer / stop / supervise. Generated from a sentence.
ai-agent4j: agents as ordinary Java
ReAct agents, tools, skills, memory, RAG, budgets, one contract
over Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, xAI, Perplexity, Kimi, Qwen,
Sarvam, Ollama and any OpenAI-style server. No vendor SDKs.
eval4j: know it works
AssertJ for agents, LLM judges, golden
datasets, a report you open and share,
prompt A/B and an optimizer.
Fabric: watch it live
Cost, context windows, incidents, injection
and trifecta signals, a time bar, and
Pause / Suspend / Stop. One page or a fleet.
Secure by construction
Approvals, budgets, journaled effects,
PII masking, secrets, weave audit mapped
to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM apps.
BUILDING BLOCKS YOU PLUG IN
Engram memory · Addons: local ONNX embeddings, pgvector, Pinecone · Tools: webhook, email, http, file, shell, read-only SQL
MCP servers and OpenAPI as tools · Classification · Spring Boot starter · Docker, compose and Kubernetes from the script
DESCRIBE · BUILD · REVIEW · TEST · EVALUATE · WATCH · LEARN · SHIP
